Name: Chum Pedal
Author: Welsh
Description: Use an Elgato Stream Deck Pedal to play Chumthesizer: each of the 3 pedals fires a pad/trigger in the synth. Forwards presses to Chumthesizer over a localhost WebSocket so it works while the Stream Deck software owns the device.

Actions.Name: Chum Pedal
Actions.Tooltip: Press to fire a pad/trigger in Chumthesizer. Put it on all 3 pedals.
